programme.title: Juntos Esta Navidad
programme.desc: Tras una ruptura amorosa, ISABEL decide alquilar una pequeña casita navideña en un apartado pueblito, para pasar la temporada decembrina trabajando en su libro. Pero el viudo JUAN ANDRÉS y su hija LAURITA han tenido la misma idea. Por un error les alquilan la misma casa. La zona está llena por la temporada y se ven obligados a compartir el lugar, en principio por una noche. Pero una serie de circunstancias hacen que la situación se alargue. La magia navideña hace de las suyas y, poco a poco, entre ISABEL y JUAN ANDRÉS surge una atracción muy especial.

programme.title: Una Navidad Para Recordar
programme.desc: Sebastián detesta la navidad. Y esta le será particularmente difícil, puesto que es la primera que pasa sin sus hijos, después de un duro divorcio. Decide alejarse de la ciudad y pasar la temporada en la casa en que nació, visitando a su madre Ángela, que padece alzheimer. En esa breve y nostálgica temporada, SEBASTIÁN reencuentra la fe en la vida, se reconcilia con la familia, consigue un nuevo camino para el amor y recupera la emoción de la Navidad.

programme.title: Una Navidad Complicada
programme.desc: En medio de la temporada navideña, Leticia y Guillermo, divorciados desde hace años, enfrentan una situación inesperada cuando su hijo adolescente recurre a una trampa para reunirlos, falsificando un correo electrónico conde invita a Guillermo y su nueva novia a la casa familiar para Navidad. A medida que la forzada convivencia avanza, la relación entre Guillermo y su exesposa va cambiando. Guillermo descubre cuanto extraña su antigua vida, su vida familiar estable y hermosa. Y descubre que sigue amando a Leticia. Pero, para regresar definitivamente, necesita ganarse el perdón de Leticia y demostrarle que está dispuesto a cambiar. No es tan fácil, pero tal vez el espíritu navideño ayude a que suceda el milagro.

programme.title: Mi Amor en Navidad
programme.desc: LUCAS es un famoso cantante. Su tema navideño “Mi Amor en Navidad” ha sido un hit desde hace casi dos décadas. Pero ya no siente deseos de seguir interpretando esta canción. Un diciembre decide tomarse unas vacaciones para reflexionar sobre su carrera y sobre su futuro y regresa al pueblo donde creció. Allí se rencuentra con ELISA, su amor de juventud y conoce a JORGE, el hijo adolescente de ELISA, que sueña con llegar a ser músico. A través de ellos se conecta con sus raíces y sus recuerdos y consigue de nuevo esos motivos que una vez lo enamoraron de la música, de la navidad… ¡y de Elisa!

programme.title: El Sabor de la Navidad
programme.desc: Una pequeña empresa familiar de Rompope enfrenta una encrucijada cuando una transnacional decide cerrar sus puertas en plena temporada navideña. Gregorio, un ambicioso ejecutivo, es el encargado de supervisar el cierre de la empresa local. Pero, al llegar, es recibido con calidez y hospitalidad por los trabajadores de la empresa, especialmente por Erica, la directora de la planta, que cree que su intención es aumentar la producción. Poco a poco Gregorio se sumerge en la magia de la comunidad, comenzando a cuestionar sus propias lealtades y enamorándose del lugar y de Erica. Gregorio terminará enfrentando a su empresa para salvar a la embotelladora y a sus trabajadores y así ganarse el corazón de Erica.

programme.title: Novios Por Navidad
programme.desc: VALERIA siempre soñó con una boda navideña. Y cuando se hizo planificadora de eventos, eso se convirtió en su sello. Cuando decidió casarse con BERNARDO planificó su boda para Diciembre. Pero no contaba con que TERE, su mejor amiga, terminaría robándole el novio y la idea. Tere le pide a Valeria que organicé su boda para navidad. Valeria acepta y decide presentarse a la boda del brazo del novio perfecto. Pero para ello necesita conseguir un novio con urgencia. Y no se le ocurre mejor idea que pedirle a CAMILO, el dueño de la finca colonial que han alquilado para la boda, que se haga pasar por su novio. Valeria y Camilo son polos opuestos, pero la magia de la navidad hace lo suyo y la mentira termina convirtiéndose en un inesperado romance.

programme.title: Una Navidad Para Recordar
programme.desc: Sebastián detesta la navidad. Y esta le será particularmente difícil, puesto que es la primera que pasa sin sus hijos, después de un duro divorcio. Decide alejarse de la ciudad y pasar la temporada en la casa en que nació, visitando a su madre Ángela, que padece alzheimer. En esa breve y nostálgica temporada, SEBASTIÁN reencuentra la fe en la vida, se reconcilia con la familia, consigue un nuevo camino para el amor y recupera la emoción de la Navidad.

programme.title: Una Navidad Complicada
programme.desc: En medio de la temporada navideña, Leticia y Guillermo, divorciados desde hace años, enfrentan una situación inesperada cuando su hijo adolescente recurre a una trampa para reunirlos, falsificando un correo electrónico conde invita a Guillermo y su nueva novia a la casa familiar para Navidad. A medida que la forzada convivencia avanza, la relación entre Guillermo y su exesposa va cambiando. Guillermo descubre cuanto extraña su antigua vida, su vida familiar estable y hermosa. Y descubre que sigue amando a Leticia. Pero, para regresar definitivamente, necesita ganarse el perdón de Leticia y demostrarle que está dispuesto a cambiar. No es tan fácil, pero tal vez el espíritu navideño ayude a que suceda el milagro.

programme.desc: Aurora, trata de esconder su gran amor con Andres, que quedo viudo cuando murio su hermana. Adan desconoce que su ex esposa Ida, no esta muerta, sospecha que algo sucedio y contrata un detective privado, ex FBI Francisco.

programme.desc: Aurora, trata de esconder su gran amor con Andres, que quedo viudo cuando murio su hermana. Adan desconoce que su ex esposa Ida, no esta muerta, sospecha que algo sucedio y contrata un detective privado, ex FBI Francisco.

programme.title: Escandalos - Hombre de Familia
programme.desc: Un veterano comediante ha sido por años estrella de televisión y símbolo de los más conservadores valores familiares, a través del programa que protagoniza. Cuando varias mujeres lo acusan de haberlas agredido sexualmente, su imagen se desmorona y la posibilidad de regresar al estrellato con un nuevo show se arruina.

programme.title: Escandalos - Sonata Nocturna
programme.desc: Una famosas concertista es acusada de abuso senil hacia su anciana madre. Entre las dos intentarán demostrar al mundo que la acusación es falsa. Pero iremos descubriendo que la enfermiza relación madre/hija es más complicada de lo que se sospecha.

programme.title: Novios Por Navidad
programme.desc: VALERIA siempre soñó con una boda navideña. Y cuando se hizo planificadora de eventos, eso se convirtió en su sello. Cuando decidió casarse con BERNARDO planificó su boda para Diciembre. Pero no contaba con que TERE, su mejor amiga, terminaría robándole el novio y la idea. Tere le pide a Valeria que organicé su boda para navidad. Valeria acepta y decide presentarse a la boda del brazo del novio perfecto. Pero para ello necesita conseguir un novio con urgencia. Y no se le ocurre mejor idea que pedirle a CAMILO, el dueño de la finca colonial que han alquilado para la boda, que se haga pasar por su novio. Valeria y Camilo son polos opuestos, pero la magia de la navidad hace lo suyo y la mentira termina convirtiéndose en un inesperado romance.

programme.title: Mi Amor en Navidad
programme.desc: LUCAS es un famoso cantante. Su tema navideño “Mi Amor en Navidad” ha sido un hit desde hace casi dos décadas. Pero ya no siente deseos de seguir interpretando esta canción. Un diciembre decide tomarse unas vacaciones para reflexionar sobre su carrera y sobre su futuro y regresa al pueblo donde creció. Allí se rencuentra con ELISA, su amor de juventud y conoce a JORGE, el hijo adolescente de ELISA, que sueña con llegar a ser músico. A través de ellos se conecta con sus raíces y sus recuerdos y consigue de nuevo esos motivos que una vez lo enamoraron de la música, de la navidad… ¡y de Elisa!

programme.title: Una Deliciosa Navidad
programme.desc: Máximo y Luciana son amantes de la cocina. Pero hasta allí llegan sus coincidencias. Él es un prestigioso chef apasionado por la comida molecular, y ella es una cocinera intuitiva empeñada en rescatar los sabores de su tierra. Cuando el destino los junta, en plena Navidad, en el restaurante que Máximo hereda de su padre y que Luciana regenta, la combinación es explosiva. Pero también deliciosa.

programme.title: Tomame o Dejame
programme.desc: Helena, se va de la casa de Andres, al verlo enamorado de otra mujer, la mama de Adan. Se sospecha que Adan y Lara son hermanos.

programme.title: Tomame o Dejame
programme.desc: Leonardo, empieza a escuchar y seguir a escondidas los consejos de Adan en sexo tantrico, para mejor su vida sexual con Lara. Francisco interroga a la mama de Adan sospechando que tiene que ver con la desaparicion de su esposa.

programme.title: Escandalos - El Doble
programme.desc: Siempre ha existido la teoría de que uno de los integrantes de una famosa banda de rock de los 60`s falleció y fue suplantado por un doble. El asunto vuelve a la palestra cuando un joven asegura ser el hijo del cantante fallecido y tener pruebas del fraude.

programme.title: Escandalos - El Psiquiatra
programme.desc: Una joven y despechada paciente del célebre Doctor Nicolás Arreaza, revela la secreta relación del ex Político con la periodista Leonor Reina, casada con Secretario General de la Asociación de Médicos. El escándalo descubre el perverso uso que de la sicoterapia lleva años ejerciendo el siquiatra de presidentes; de esposas de poderosos; de famosas y de las jóvenes de las familias más adineradas del país.

programme.title: El Sabor de la Navidad
programme.desc: Una pequeña empresa familiar de Rompope enfrenta una encrucijada cuando una transnacional decide cerrar sus puertas en plena temporada navideña. Gregorio, un ambicioso ejecutivo, es el encargado de supervisar el cierre de la empresa local. Pero, al llegar, es recibido con calidez y hospitalidad por los trabajadores de la empresa, especialmente por Erica, la directora de la planta, que cree que su intención es aumentar la producción. Poco a poco Gregorio se sumerge en la magia de la comunidad, comenzando a cuestionar sus propias lealtades y enamorándose del lugar y de Erica. Gregorio terminará enfrentando a su empresa para salvar a la embotelladora y a sus trabajadores y así ganarse el corazón de Erica.

programme.title: Juntos Esta Navidad
programme.desc: Tras una ruptura amorosa, ISABEL decide alquilar una pequeña casita navideña en un apartado pueblito, para pasar la temporada decembrina trabajando en su libro. Pero el viudo JUAN ANDRÉS y su hija LAURITA han tenido la misma idea. Por un error les alquilan la misma casa. La zona está llena por la temporada y se ven obligados a compartir el lugar, en principio por una noche. Pero una serie de circunstancias hacen que la situación se alargue. La magia navideña hace de las suyas y, poco a poco, entre ISABEL y JUAN ANDRÉS surge una atracción muy especial.

programme.title: Intercambio Navideno
programme.desc: MAYA y ANA MARÍA son gemelas. Pero fueron separadas al nacer y entregadas a diferentes familias. Fueron criadas de maneras opuestas. ANA MARÍA es ahora una exitosa empresaria divorciada, que solo piensa en su éxito y en el trabajo. MAYA una incansable filántropa, criada por una familia que se dedica a trabajar en pro de los más necesitados. Ya adultas se descubren una a la otra y deciden guardar el secreto, para no hacer daño a sus familias. Pero una navidad deciden hacer la travesura de intercambiar sus vidas por una noche. Sin sospechar que aquella decisión las cambiará para siempre.

programme.title: Escandalos - Siempre Fui Una Mujer
programme.desc: Un ex medallista olímpico, celebridad de televisión, luego de haber tenido seis hijos con tres esposas diferentes, decide separarse de su última esposa, con quien había conseguido estar en la cima de la fama mundial gracias a un exitosísimo Reality Show. A sus sesenta y cinco años, quiere convertirse en mujer, pero sus hijastras, famosas socialités, quieren convertir su decisión en un espectáculo.

programme.title: Escandalos - La Perfecta Ama de Casa
programme.sub-title: Escandalos - La Perfecta Ama de Casa
programme.desc: La perfecta ama de casa, magnate de la cocina y la decoración, la reina de los negocios del hogar que hizo de su vida la perfección, se equivoca en un detalle y es castigada por la ley. En su caída es mucho lo que pierde pero logra recuperar el amor de su hija.

programme.title: Escandalos - Horario Protegido
programme.desc: La joven protagonista de una super exitosa serie para adolescentes sale embarazada. El padre es la estrella del canal rival, quien está a punto de casarse con su co-protagonista. Los canales harán lo imposible para evitar que el escándalo perjudique sus programas

programme.title: Escandalos - La Ultima Cancion
programme.desc: Una famosa cantante folk muere es dada por muerta tras un accidente de aviación. Pero meses más tarde comienza a correr el rumor de que sigue con vida. Un periodista comienza a investigar el caso revelando oscuros secretos de la vida de la celebridad.

programme.title: Escandalos - Hombre de Familia
programme.desc: Un veterano comediante ha sido por años estrella de televisión y símbolo de los más conservadores valores familiares, a través del programa que protagoniza. Cuando varias mujeres lo acusan de haberlas agredido sexualmente, su imagen se desmorona y la posibilidad de regresar al estrellato con un nuevo show se arruina.

programme.title: Escandalos - Sonata Nocturna
programme.desc: Una famosas concertista es acusada de abuso senil hacia su anciana madre. Entre las dos intentarán demostrar al mundo que la acusación es falsa. Pero iremos descubriendo que la enfermiza relación madre/hija es más complicada de lo que se sospecha.

programme.title: Escandalos - El Doble
programme.desc: Siempre ha existido la teoría de que uno de los integrantes de una famosa banda de rock de los 60`s falleció y fue suplantado por un doble. El asunto vuelve a la palestra cuando un joven asegura ser el hijo del cantante fallecido y tener pruebas del fraude.

programme.title: Escandalos - El Psiquiatra
programme.desc: Una joven y despechada paciente del célebre Doctor Nicolás Arreaza, revela la secreta relación del ex Político con la periodista Leonor Reina, casada con Secretario General de la Asociación de Médicos. El escándalo descubre el perverso uso que de la sicoterapia lleva años ejerciendo el siquiatra de presidentes; de esposas de poderosos; de famosas y de las jóvenes de las familias más adineradas del país.

programme.title: Escandalos - El Precio de la Ambicion
programme.sub-title: Escandalos - El Precio de la Ambicion
programme.desc: El presidente del Fondo Bancario de las Américas es acusado de agredir y someter a la camarera de un hotel. Todo parece indicar que se trata de un complot para acabar con el prestigio del funcionario internacional.

programme.title: Tomame o Dejame
programme.desc: Aurora, trata de esconder su gran amor con Andres, que quedo viudo cuando murio su hermana. Adan desconoce que su ex esposa Ida, no esta muerta, sospecha que algo sucedio y contrata un detective privado, ex FBI Francisco.

programme.title: Tomame o Dejame
programme.desc: Danny, deja ver que a pesar de su sobrepeso, es la mujer mas exitosa en el sexo por su seguridad e indiferencia con los hombres.

programme.title: Tomame o Dejame
programme.desc: Ocurre el primer encuentro entre Adan y Lara. A lara la despinden del canal por bajos rating desde que inicio el programa de Adan

programme.title: Tomame o Dejame
programme.desc: Jennifer como amante del dueno del canal, sigue planificanco su venganza contra Lara para que no vuelva al canal.

programme.title: Tomame o Dejame
programme.desc: Helena, se va de la casa de Andres, al verlo enamorado de otra mujer, la mama de Adan. Se sospecha que Adan y Lara son hermanos.

programme.title: Adam and Evelyn
programme.desc: Summer 1989, East Germany. Adam works as a tailor, Evelyn as a waitress. They are planning a vacation together when Evelyn finds out that Adam is cheating on her and decides to leave for the holiday on her own.

programme.title: Miracle in the Valley
programme.desc: Thirteen-year-old Melinda is determined to find out what happened to her real Daddy, and no one in Boonville will help her.

programme.title: Estanislao
programme.desc: A deceitful and unemployed 40-year-old man returns to the house of his mother, who has recently passed away, to spend time with his alcoholic father and with a strange monster that oozes skin pieces, employed as fabric on the family's tailor shop business.

programme.title: Resentment
programme.desc: At the age of 30, Galina is looking for love, but meets a good soldier only for war.

programme.title: Insane
programme.desc: A woman gets kidnapped in the middle of the day and is tortured in a psychiatric hospital. A Journalist gets on the trace of the case and tries to find out the truth.

programme.title: Irene in Time
programme.desc: A film about the complex relationships between fathers and daughters, and the potential lifelong consequences of those relationships.

programme.title: Drown the Clown
programme.desc: A newly hired night watchwoman's deceased child's clown doll goes missing from her place of work and starts appearing in places it shouldn't weakening her already fragile sanity.

programme.title: A Dream Called Death
programme.desc: An introvert and Schizophrenic young man finds the "Perfect Cure" to his mental illness in the form of a damsel whom he considers to be the "Woman of his dream," but his dream somewhat turns out to be a nightmare for him and everyone around him!

programme.title: Lemonade
programme.desc: Mara, a young Romanian woman, has just moved to the US with Dragos, her 9-year-old son, marrying Daniel, an American she has met only a few months ago. The film follows her through a series of revealing encounters during one day, from her problems of babysitting, her unplanned and uncomfortable meeting with a U.S. immigration official, to dealing with the police about her son she had to leave in a motel room and the bank issue for a loan with her husband.

programme.title: When The Smoke Clears
programme.desc: When Kiran Met Karen (WKMK) is a cross-cultured romance set in New York. Chriselle Almeida plays Kiran Lohar, a famous Bollywood actress, who has come to New York to promote her new film ?A Himalayan Love Story?, and spend time with her fianc? Dev Ghosh, a rich and successful musician. At the press conference, Kiran meets a lesbian journalist Karen Sorens. There is an instant connection, attraction. What happens in next few days is the crux of the story. Will Kiran come out of the closet, or will she fear Bollywood ? the industry that gave her the stardom

programme.title: Maggie
programme.desc: A couple's hospital tryst is caught on X-Ray. Thinking she and her boyfriend are the ones in the compromising radiograph, nurse Yoon-young goes in the next day to resign only to find that everyone has called in sick except the head doctor.

programme.title: Teen Idol Tom
programme.desc: Actress Fiona Torrant is one of the elite orphans selected by the exclusive and powerful Font, the nations only academy for the arts, where stars are regularly groomed for enormous fame.

programme.title: 180 Degree Rule
programme.desc: A school teacher from Tehran is preparing to attend a wedding in northern Iran. When her husband suddenly forbids her to go, she makes a choice that will place her on a painful path zig to atonement.

programme.title: Love and a Tragedy
programme.desc: A Mother's devious ploy to ensure her only son marries the right woman seems like the most perfect plan in the world until it boomerangs and lead to a series of unprecedented events.

programme.title: Sweet Face
programme.desc: Tobi and Nkem are deeply in love, and very tight knit.. They struggle with the difficulty in conceiving a child. Nkem eventually gets pregnant and 5 months into the pregnancy they are told by their doctor that their unborn baby has a congenital disorder (down syndrome). They are distraught by this bad news and are torn between keeping their baby or getting rid of it. The decision could drastically affect their marriage and reshape the rest of their lives.

programme.title: Erased
programme.desc: Ana gives birth at the local hospital and everything goes well. There is only a small problem with the paperwork - her file is not on the computer. A temporary loss of data seems to be caused by a software glitch, nothing to worry about. Within a few days, Ana is entangled in a web of bureaucracy of Kafkaesque proportions: not being in the computer means no social security, no permanent address and no baby.

programme.title: The Church Office
programme.desc: Faith, Friendship, and Forgiveness.

programme.title: The Chosen Ones
programme.desc: A modernized retelling of the life of Jesus Christ. This modern day Savior sets out on a mission to confront the wrongs of this world with what is right and to erase the lies with the truth. All in the effort to spread love and understanding. Very quickly this Savior realizes he will need help. He brings together twelve delinquents and embark upon the journey of a lifetime. This journey is complicated by the fact that our Savior, at times, is much more human than superhuman.

programme.title: Whatever It Takes
programme.desc: Based on a true story. Two beautiful Russian women endure terrible hardships in their native land, and come to the United States in search of opportunity and hope.

programme.title: Consequences
programme.desc: Reformed internet scammers who reinvent their old business; this time only targeting immoral people.

programme.title: Cold By Nature
programme.desc: Caleb Bodine and his mother Rachel, ardent animal rights activists, secretly kidnap and rescue animals subjected to cruel laboratory testing at the Chemtech Pharmaceutical Corporation, owned by Caleb’s own cold-blooded cousin, Cole.

programme.title: Time Looped
programme.desc: A stubborn young man is trapped living the same day over and over, until he learns to be a better husband.

programme.title: The 2 Pilots
programme.desc: Get ready for a rib-tickling adventure as two comical con artists imagine themselves as pilots, with passengers on board! Will they soar or crash? Find out in this uproarious high-flying comedy!

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila pressures Alfredo by continuing with her plan, she reveals that Alfredo is her godmother's son, whom she abandoned when he was almost born. Elda alone, crying, because deep down she is not happy with what she did. Sebastian, shocked, when Axel confesses that Amelia's son is his.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Max informs Camila that he knows the whereabouts of Rosa Blanco. Fausto enjoys harassing Patricia and that he will pay, like Rosa Blanco, for a crime he did not commit. Alfredo goes to talk to Elda, he despises her as a mother, guilt and remorse torment her: it is part of the revenge for his betrayal of Rosa Blanco.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila accepts that Max is the man she has loved the most and confides that she feels a great hatred for Marcelina, because being her mother's best friend, she was the one who betrayed her the worst and left her in the street, when she was only a five year old girl. Max refuses to believe it.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila and Rosa swear that now nothing and no one can separate them. Rosa wants to be reunited with her sister, Mother Isabel. Rosa, alone with her sister, shows her true face: cold, calm and above all vengeful. The two sisters confront each other over what they want for Camila.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Max now understands why Camila did not marry him. Max and Camila meet with Rosa. Rosa Blanco and Fausto plan to ally themselves to bring down Ezequiel, but he does not trust her and thinks it is a trap for him and so he decides to ally himself with Ezequiel, with the purpose of murdering Rosa.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Inspector Torrealba demands that Rosa testify about what happened in the past crime of Leoncio Lopez Mendez. With pain she relives the moments when Ezequiel arrived and murdered Leoncio and then left the place without any remorse. Fausto and Ezequiel continue with their plan to murder Rosa Blanco so that she does not tell what she knows.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: During an event in Mascarada Rosa is received by Camila to enjoy seeing all her enemies gathered in the same place. Ezequiel and Fausto each celebrate the fall of the other and are united only by their intention to kill Rosa; Marcelina, feels fear and shame; Elda, assures that Rosa is there to take revenge. Projection of the video that shows how Fausto murdered Celso.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Ezequiel receives a note from El Doliente, anticipating his death. The plan against Rosa Blanco failed. She continues to relate the events of the past; Ezequiel, forcing her to take the murder weapon, managed to get her to be blamed for this murder, for which she paid so many years of unjust imprisonment.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Ezequiel tries to abuse Camila, a gloved hand hits him. Everyone blames Camila and she defends herself saying she did not see the murderer. Torrealba insists on interrogating her. Everyone: Octavia, Astrid, Max, Marcelina, Leandro, Gregorio and even Sebastián had motives to kill Ezequiel. Only Max is arrested, as the presumed perpetrator of the crime.

programme.title: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.title: KOLs and other ways to connect cultures
programme.desc: In what ways can KOLs better use their power in an age where a single video can reach millions? programme.title: KOL traffic secrets: the power to drive change #GlobalSouthNextGen Behind the scenes
programme.desc: How do creators build traffic on social media? How can that influence spark real changes in society? In a cozy siheyuan, the iconic Beijing courtyard, another episode of #GlobalSouthNextGen: Voices and Visions brings together two KOLs who open up about their journeys, their strategies, and the impact from their content. Click into the Behind the Scenes video to find out more!

programme.title: Auto China: Driving future of mobility
programme.desc: Auto China 2026 opens on April 24, showcasing nearly 1,500 vehicles over 10 days – at a pivotal turning point for China's automotive industry. Amid commodity volatility and fractured supply chains, electrification is no longer a question of “if” but “how fast.” As the world’s largest electric vehicle (EV) market and a major force of global EV sales, how is China shaping the pace and direction of this charge towards greener, smarter vehicles? Join us on BizTalk this week as we explore how China and Germany are moving in step toward the next phase of the future of mobility.

programme.title: Highland industries, high-quality future
programme.desc: From smart ranching to vegetable greenhouses, from cold-chain logistics to cross-border trade… We take a look at Xizang's industrial transformation and see how the plateau is leaping into a new era of development.

programme.title: Meet China
programme.desc: CGTN launches a brand-new original program, Meet China, dedicated to showcasing China's vitality, strength, and potential. The program covers a wide range of topics, including the economy, innovation, culture, and exploration. Join us on a journey to experience the vibrant pulse of China's economy and immerse yourself in the rich tapestry of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Around China: Step Into Xishuangbanna’s Everyday Life at the Ganlanba Market
programme.desc: Beneath the Ganlanba Bridge in Xishuangbanna, a local market has become part of everyday life for residents. From street-side snacks to regional specialties like ganbai chicken and sticky rice cakes, the market is filled with the sights, sounds and flavors of daily life. Guided by local residents, CGTN reporter Elle Liao takes you inside the market to capture the most authentic rhythm of life in Yunnan.

programme.title: China Agenda 2026
programme.desc: Special coverage of China's annual sessions of its top legislature and political advisory body, known as the "Two Sessions".

programme.title: China's concert boom: Why Gen Z is filling the stadiums
programme.desc:
From packed stadium shows to sold-out performances in smaller cities, China's live music scene is expanding rapidly. Young audiences are turning concerts into a cultural routine: traveling across cities, sharing the experience online and building collective memories around live performances.
The boom now extends far beyond the stage, boosting tourism, retail spending and local economies. In this episode of Unboxing China, we explore how concerts are reshaping consumption patterns and becoming a new driver of cultural and urban development.

programme.title: The self-care economy explained: How emotional spending is reshaping consumer trends
programme.desc:
For months, Chinese social feeds have been filled with "Lao Ji"- a third-person way of saying "me." What began as a slang sign-off, "Love you, Lao Ji. See you tomorrow," now signals a broader shift toward self-care and emotional self-support. It also feeds a huge market where young consumers are rechanneling budgets toward small, meaningful purchases that support emotional wellbeing.
In this episode of Unboxing China, we trace how a casual phrase turned into a cultural movement, reshaping consumption and mental-health talk.

programme.title: RAZOR: Wooden Windmills
programme.desc: As we shift to green energy, it's important to ask—how green is the infrastructure itself? Take wind power: a typical onshore turbine needs around 480 tonnes of steel, and producing just one tonne of steel or cement releases up to two tonnes of CO2. In Sweden, engineers at Modvion are tackling this problem by building wind turbine towers out of wood. RAZOR meets the team behind Wind of Change, one of the tallest wooden towers in the world. Co-founder David Olivegren got the idea while building a boat, while CEO Otto Lundman explains how sustainably sourced wood is turned into strong, lightweight Laminated Veneer Lumber (LVL). CFO Maria-Lina Hedlund shares how the company aims to scale in a competitive green energy market.

programme.title: RAZOR: Predicting Volcanic Eruptions
programme.desc: Volcanoes rank among Earth's most powerful natural forces, shaping 80% of our planet's surface. Iceland, known as the land of fire and ice, owes its dynamic terrain to its location on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, a tectonic boundary where the Eurasian and North American plates diverge. The frequent and varied eruptions here are a subject of great scientific interest. RAZOR's Reya El-Salahi meets a team of Volcanologists at the Nordic Volcanological Centre, at the University of Iceland, to find out how they are studying the most recent string of eruptions to uncover new details about this powerful geological process.

programme.title: Start small, dream big: Young entrepreneurs shape our future
programme.desc: Tune in to #GlobalSouthNextGen: Voices and Visions! Hear the incredible stories of the young entrepreneurs who are doing things differently. One connects beauty services with people in need, while the other turns waste into sustainable solutions, all while lifting up their communities. Don’t you miss this!

programme.title: Startup Secrets & Backstage Gossip! #GlobalSouthNextGen Behind the scenes
programme.desc: Ever thought of turning human hair waste into sustainable products? How can young people take their first step in initiating their own business? At Suzhou Pingjiang Cultural Center, another episode of #GlobalSouthNextGen: Voices and Visions invites two young entrepreneurs to share their amazing stories. Click into the BehindTheScenes video to find out more!

programme.title: Discovering Guizhou: The Guitar Fanatic
programme.desc: In Zheng'an County, Guizhou province, a thriving guitar manufacturing industry has emerged, supplying major international brands and providing thousands of jobs. In this episode, we meet the guitar-makers, the musicians, and the dreamers who've transformed an entire region by turning strings into stories.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: How to build a digital twin of a city？
programme.desc: As cities expand and grow more intricate, a new kind of specialist is emerging behind the scenes: the urban digital twin engineer. In the coastal city of Qingdao, these experts are using real-time data and AI to build virtual replicas of the city—helping predict risks, improve infrastructure, and protect the public. CGTN's Liu Jiaxin takes us inside this fast-growing field.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: From trash to treasure
programme.desc: Jiao Jianwei is a senior engineer at the Longgang Energy Eco-Park inShenzhen. Every day, the facility processes 5,000 tonnes of waste, burning it togenerate electricity that powers millions of homes. The leftover ash is alsoturned into eco-bricks, used to pave city roads. From landfills to incineration,China has transformed its waste industry with advanced technologies. Today,the country operates more than 1,000 waste-to-energy plants – nearly half theworld's total. With national goals like "carbon neutrality" and "zero-wastecities" taking shape, engineers like Jiao are turning trash into treasure.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: Who runs China's sea-roving protein factory?
programme.desc: Ever seen "fishermen" farming salmon on a vessel with a displacement bigger than some aircraft carriers? On China's Suhai-1 – the world's first deep-sea salmon and trout aquaculture vessel – these cold-water, high-latitude fish are now thriving far from their natural habitat.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: China's Drone Show Flight Planners
programme.desc: From the skies above Chongqing, thousands of drones light up the night in dazzling displays. Behind the spectacle, a new generation of artists and engineers is redefining entertainment – and showcasing China's growing technological and economic ambitions. In this story, we take a look at the work of a drone show flight planner.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: Standing with sea giants
programme.desc: Along China's eastern shoreline, a new generation of energy workers is redefining what it meansto go to work. For offshore wind engineers, the office is the open sea. In this episode of ourspecial series Jobs 2.0, CGTN reporter Wang Tianyu takes us aboard to follow an engineer livingand working above the waves.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: Who's teaching the robots to work?
programme.desc: As robots gradually move from research labs into real-world tasks, a key question emerges: how do machines learn to handle complex, delicate work? At a Beijing robotics company, engineers are hand-training robotic hands, translating human experience into digital skills that can be replicated at scale. CGTN's Yang Xinmeng explores this emerging profession, speaking with the people who teach machines to cook, care, and manipulate objects with precision. Their work offers a rare glimpse into the intersection of human ingenuity and artificial intelligence – and into the ways humans and robots may collaborate in everyday life.

programme.title: China Agenda 2026
programme.desc: Special coverage of China's annual sessions of its top legislature and political advisory body, known as the "Two Sessions".

programme.title: China's concert boom: Why Gen Z is filling the stadiums
programme.desc:
From packed stadium shows to sold-out performances in smaller cities, China's live music scene is expanding rapidly. Young audiences are turning concerts into a cultural routine: traveling across cities, sharing the experience online and building collective memories around live performances.
The boom now extends far beyond the stage, boosting tourism, retail spending and local economies. In this episode of Unboxing China, we explore how concerts are reshaping consumption patterns and becoming a new driver of cultural and urban development.

programme.title: The self-care economy explained: How emotional spending is reshaping consumer trends
programme.desc:
For months, Chinese social feeds have been filled with "Lao Ji"- a third-person way of saying "me." What began as a slang sign-off, "Love you, Lao Ji. See you tomorrow," now signals a broader shift toward self-care and emotional self-support. It also feeds a huge market where young consumers are rechanneling budgets toward small, meaningful purchases that support emotional wellbeing.
In this episode of Unboxing China, we trace how a casual phrase turned into a cultural movement, reshaping consumption and mental-health talk.

programme.title: RAZOR: Wooden Windmills
programme.desc: As we shift to green energy, it's important to ask—how green is the infrastructure itself? Take wind power: a typical onshore turbine needs around 480 tonnes of steel, and producing just one tonne of steel or cement releases up to two tonnes of CO2. In Sweden, engineers at Modvion are tackling this problem by building wind turbine towers out of wood. RAZOR meets the team behind Wind of Change, one of the tallest wooden towers in the world. Co-founder David Olivegren got the idea while building a boat, while CEO Otto Lundman explains how sustainably sourced wood is turned into strong, lightweight Laminated Veneer Lumber (LVL). CFO Maria-Lina Hedlund shares how the company aims to scale in a competitive green energy market.

programme.title: RAZOR: Predicting Volcanic Eruptions
programme.desc: Volcanoes rank among Earth's most powerful natural forces, shaping 80% of our planet's surface. Iceland, known as the land of fire and ice, owes its dynamic terrain to its location on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, a tectonic boundary where the Eurasian and North American plates diverge. The frequent and varied eruptions here are a subject of great scientific interest. RAZOR's Reya El-Salahi meets a team of Volcanologists at the Nordic Volcanological Centre, at the University of Iceland, to find out how they are studying the most recent string of eruptions to uncover new details about this powerful geological process.

programme.title: Yves Saint Laurent -Creador De Fuego
programme.desc: We explore YSL's unparalleled professional acclaim, as well as his fascinating and tumultuous personal life. YSL was able to adapt his style to accommodate the changes in fashion during his entire career. He approached fashion with a different narrative by wanting women to look comfortable yet elegant at the same time.

programme.title: Oh Dior!
programme.desc: Sabbatical Entertainment's exclusive original documentary admires Christian Dior, the famous French fashion designer whose post-World War II creations were wildly popular and whose legacy continues to influence the fashion industry.

programme.title: Eastwood
programme.desc: Pay homage to Clint Eastwood, the oldest living cinematic icon. Success did not come easy for Eastwood, but throughout his career he has reaped numerous triumphs, directed more than 44 films, and acted in more than 72... Winner of over 150 awards including four Oscars, the iconic Eastwood has not only secured his place in the history of Hollywood, but in the history of world cinema. Bravo!!!

Not afraid of controversy, the Material girl, through her talents, redefined pop culture history.

programme.title: Dances with the Wind
programme.desc: ‘Fury Dance’ is a story about a Korean protest dancer, Sam-hun Lee. He fought for the democratization of South Korea in the ‘80’s through dance, while giving up his own dream to become a ballerino. The film takes the viewer through prominent events in South Korean history, as Sam-hun dances to soothe the souls of victims who were killed by the Korean national violence during the past 30 years. During the 1980 Gwangju Massacre however, Sam-hun developed a panic disorder. So he crosses through the Eurasian rail with difficulty when invited to attend a festival to dance in France. Through his journey, he attempts to overcome his claustrophobic fears in France, revisits his lost dream of becoming a ballerino in Russia, and dances for the Holocaust victims in Poland. Documented for 15 years, this film is dedicated to those who lost their noble lives while fighting for freedom against the unjust political power.

programme.title: Frank & Fearless
programme.desc: An aging reprobate, a rural boy, a large dog and an orphaned baby rhino set out to stop the rhino slaughter. Their quest buffets them between high comedy and searing tragedy, until they end up an inspiration and a conscience to a world in need of heroes.

programme.title: Making Out
programme.desc: A screenwriter and self-proclaimed hopeless romantic meets a beautiful actress and they decide to act out their ideal love scenarios. When real feelings start to jump off the page and become real will he tell her how he feels? They're in love, probably.

programme.title: Beach Babe Bingo
programme.desc: The water is cool and the girls are hot, what more could you want? Jump in and go for a swim, then wash up for a fun night out because the beach has nothing but sand and babes.

programme.title: Running Funny
programme.desc: Michael and Eddie are two broke college graduates who rent an “apartment” from Stan, a cantankerous blind war veteran. As they begin their tumultuous transition into the real world, they quickly discover that finding a job will be more complex than securing their degrees.

programme.title: Cabin of Errors
programme.desc: When Peter and Nancy split up, their friends plot to bring them back together during a trip to a cabin. But things go hilariously wrong when Peter comes to the cabin with other intentions. A modern day romantic comedy farce.

programme.title: 1st Bite
programme.desc: Set on a tropical island in Thailand, the strange plight of a beleaguered chef who, while romancing a mysterious woman, discovers the diabolical Zen of cooking. Following a near death escape, he returns to Montreal and falls hard for the woman of his life who unfortunately craves only his cooking but not his loving. Worse still, strange things surfacing around him indicate that his journey to the Far East has deep, divine implications. The stage is set for him to take the 1st bite of true love and end the cycle of suffering for all involved.

Este martes en Ministerio de Brujas (19:00h España, en Canal Barro), las ministras abrieron los portales del poder para leer las cartas astrales de Pedro Sánchez y Begoña Gómez 🔥. Lo que descubrieron dejó a todos con la boca abierta: ♑ Él, un hombre obsesionado con el poder, encantador pero peligroso en su ingenuidad. ♌ Ella, inteligente, estratega y con los pantalones del vínculo.
Además, en la Hoguera semanal ardieron los males cotidianos: 🚗 los Uber que nunca llegan, 😤 la gente que mastica con la boca abierta, ⚧ y un intenso debate sobre identidad y transparencia en las relaciones.
La bruja invitada de la semana fue Mercedes Jorqueira, voluntaria de la DANA, que contó en directo su experiencia ayudando en plena catástrofe. En el Departamento de Cinematografía Zodíacal, se recomendaron películas y series de desastres como Chernóbil y Lo imposible. Y en el Archivo de Brujas Quemadas, se honró la figura inmortal de Mercedes Sosa 🎶, voz y fuego eterno de América Latina.
✨ Ministerio de Brujas — el programa donde el poder se lee en las estrellas, se quema en la hoguera y se transforma en conciencia. Todos los martes a las 19:00h (España) en YouTube @arroba.barro.
#MinisterioDeBrujas #PedroSanchez #BegoñaGomez #Astrología #Brujas #CanalBarro #CartaAstral #MercedesSosa

programme.title: Afrontar la adolescencia de tus hijos, Duelo emocional de las madre, Momento de DESmadre Podcast
programme.desc:
En este episodio de Momento de DESmadre, conversamos con la terapeuta familiar Erika Ángulo sobre uno de los temas más desafiantes para muchas madres: la adolescencia de los hijos y el duelo emocional que sentimos al verlos crecer y empezar a soltarse de nuestra mano.
Hablamos sobre cómo manejar la etapa de la "aborrecencia", entender los cambios emocionales y de comportamiento de los adolescentes, y cómo las mamás podemos vivir este proceso sin tanta culpa, con herramientas que nos ayuden a conectar desde el amor y la empatía.
💬 Temas que tocamos:
Cómo lidiar con la adolescencia de los hijos Qué es el duelo emocional en la maternidad Cambios emocionales en los adolescentes Cómo soltar y dejar crecer a los hijos sin dolor Consejos de una terapeuta familiar para madres 🎧 Escucha, comparte y acompáñanos en este momento de reflexión y desahogo maternal. ¡No estás sola!
🔔 Suscríbete para más conversaciones reales, sin filtros y con mucho DESmadre.
#Adolescencia #MaternidadReal #PodcastParaMujeres #DueloMaternal #MomentoDeDESmadre #ErikaÁngulo #Adolescentes #Familia #PodcastEnEspañol

programme.title: FUNDADORAS | Miriam de Paoli: romper tabúes sobre la menopausia con No Pausa.
programme.desc:
"La menopausia no es una enfermedad. Es una etapa natural de nuestras vidas." En este nuevo episodio de Fundadoras, Sabrina Díaz Ibarra conversa con Miriam de Paoli, fundadora de No Pausa, periodista, innovadora social y referente en longevidad y salud femenina.
💬 ¿Qué pasa cuando una mujer tarda más de un año en recibir un diagnóstico para una etapa natural como el climaterio? 💡 ¿Por qué seguimos en silencio sobre la menopausia? 🧠 ¿Cómo pueden la tecnología, los datos y la comunidad cambiarlo todo?
Una charla poderosa sobre romper tabúes, emprender con propósito y construir un futuro más inclusivo para las mujeres.
▶️ Suscribite al canal y activá la campanita para más entrevistas con mujeres que están transformando el mundo. 📌 Encontranos también en Instagram y LinkedIn como @sabrinadiazibarra
#Fundadoras #NoPausa #MiriamDePaoli #Menopausia #SaludFemenina #Longevidad #Climaterio #InnovaciónSocial

programme.title: FUNDADORAS | Entrevista a Helena Estrada
programme.desc:
En esta conversación, Helena Estrada nos comparte su visión sobre el liderazgo femenino, la independencia financiera y el poder de tomar las riendas de nuestra vida. Con una trayectoria que abarca el derecho, las finanzas y el coaching, nos deja reflexiones profundas sobre los desafíos y oportunidades que enfrentamos las mujeres hoy.
💬 "Estamos tan educadas en querer ser queridas..." 💬 "Un costo siempre pagamos... la pregunta es cuál es mayor en tu vida, si ser una persona o ser personaje. Y acá no hay muchos grises."
Además, nos habla sobre su más reciente libro, El viaje de la heroína (2025), y su compromiso con generar cambios reales.
Mirá la entrevista completa y dejate inspirar. ✨

programme.title: FUNDADORAS I Eli Bracciaforte: De Workana a No Pausa, liderazgo y proyectos inspiradores
programme.desc: En esta entrevista, Eliana Bracciaforte comparte su experiencia como fundadora de Workana y No Pausa, reflexiona sobre los retos de emprender desde cero, y revela cómo impulsa el crecimiento de mujeres en un mundo profesional en constante cambio. Un diálogo inspirador sobre liderazgo, aprendizajes y su compromiso con transformar la menopausia en un tema clave para el bienestar femenino.

programme.title: MINISTERIO DE BRUJAS: Carta Astral de Los Javis, Caras de Bélmez, Mal de Ojo y Venus en Escorpio.
programme.desc:
Bienvenid@s al Ministerio de Brujas, el único programa donde la magia tiene reglamento, las dudas tienen expediente y la intuición legisla sin oposición. En este episodio, grabado en vivo en@CanalBarro el aquelarre vino encendido.
🔥 PROTOCOLO DE LA HOGUERA Quemamos todo lo que necesita transformarse: los crush imposibles de tu ideología opuesta, la gente que vive diciendo “no”, los silencios incómodos del WhatsApp y esa tortura mental llamada “debería estar haciendo algo”. Aquí el fuego purifica… o al menos nos da permiso para reírnos.
💋 SECRETARÍA DE VENUS EN TANGA Nos adentramos en el magnetismo oscuro de Venus en Escorpio: deseo extremo, intensidad emocional, tabúes, renacer afectivo y ese erotismo que ve en la piel ajena un archivo confidencial. Además, tiramos una carta del tarot erótico para leer el clima del deseo.
🎬 DIRECCIÓN GENERAL DE CINEMATOGRAFÍA ZODIAZAL La Dra. Fernanda Garrido trae cine, signos y elementos. Películas que dialogan con el cielo y con nuestras crisis de identidad astrológica. Cine como brújula, literal.
✨ CLIMA ASTRAL & MITOS ChongaZen explica los movimientos planetarios y luego destapamos dos clásicos del misterio: • El Mal de Ojo: desde Mesopotamia hasta TikTok. • El espejo roto y los 7 años de mala suerte: Roma, magia y supersticiones que siguen vivitas.
👁 SUBSECRETARÍA DE MISTERIOS: LAS CARAS DE BÉLMEZ El caso paranormal más famoso de España: rostros que aparecen en el suelo, análisis forenses, sellos notariales, restos humanos bajo la casa y un misterio que ni la ciencia cerró. Brutal.
💘 DEPARTAMENTO DE ESTRELLAS Y SÁBANAS Analizamos la compatibilidad cósmica de Javier Calvo y Javier Ambrossi. Cartas natales sobre la mesa. La química astral nunca miente.
🔥 BRUJAS QUEMADAS O EXILIADAS La activista Tarana Burke, madre del movimiento Me Too, entra en nuestros Archivos Clasificados. Poder, voz y reparación.
💬 Cierre con los Sindicatos Zodiacales Acuario pide dejar de ser llamado frí@, Cáncer pregunta si hace falta sentir TODO, y Libra… Libra reclama coherencia universal.
📌 Suscríbete, activa la campanita y envíanos tu expediente esotérico a nuestro mail. 📌 Ministerio de Brujas — todos los martes a las 19h en Canal Barro.

programme.title: Creekside Cigar Co.
programme.sub-title: Creekside Cigar Co - The Most Interesting Man In Cigars
programme.desc: In this episode, Dave and BG chat with Darren Joffrey of Principal Cigars, discussing the unique concept behind his "Boy Band Volume One" cigar project, where five master blenders created cigars inspired by Nina Simone's album "I Put a Spell on You". Darren explains Principal Cigars' philosophy of focusing on flavor and "mechanics" (burn, smoke output, temperature) rather than just flavor, emphasizing that every cigar is weighed individually to ensure consistency. They also delve into the brand's commitment to constantly evolving blends with new tobacco discoveries and the importance of open communication with consumers, distinguishing them from traditional cigar marketing.

programme.desc: In this episode of the Creekside Podcast, Dave and Noah are joined by Abe Wolke, founder of Valet Humidity, to discuss his new humidity control brand and his journey from product design and tech to cigar accessories. Abe shares how the visual appeal of his product, designed with aesthetics in mind, initially caught Dave's attention, and explains Valet's approach to humidity levels, offering packs for aging (65%), airtight containers (69%), standard use (72%), and "culturing" (75%) for a unique "funky" cigar experience. They also explore the importance of human craftsmanship in cigars, the value of personalized branding for retailers, and the unique community spirit within the cigar industry, while smoking a United Cigars Gold Star.

programme.title: Celadon Ou Music
programme.desc: Celadon ou music is also called "bowl music.” The reason is that the ancient Chinese word for bowl sounds like ou. The music originated simply as improvised rhythms tapped out on bowls. It was this spontaneity that made celadon ou so popular. Celadon ou music was at the height of its popularity over 1,100 years ago. But with time, it faded from history. At one point, it was even on the verge of being lost forever. After hundreds of years of obscurity, it re-emerged at the end of last century.

programme.title: Kesi
programme.desc: Silk is a classic symbol of Chinese culture. It helped opened up economic and cultural exchanges between East and West and witnessed the spread of Eastern civilization to the world. As a representative of traditional Chinese silk art, kesi is renowned for its highly ornamental weaving techniques of highlighting warps and breaking wefts, and has been deeply loved by people for thousands of years. In folk culture, it enjoys the reputation of “an inch of kesi is worth an inch of gold.”

programme.title: A Lifelong Journey of Xuan Paper
programme.desc: The host travels to Jingxian, Anhui—known as the hometown of Xuan paper—to experience the intricate process of making this traditional paper. Along the way, they uncover the secrets behind its thousand-year legacy and witness the craftsmanship of Xuan paper inheritors at every stage. Through vivid, personal stories, the episode reveals the hidden struggles and quiet perseverance that have kept this intangible cultural heritage alive across generations.

programme.title: CULTURAL INHERITORS Inheritance matters more than fame
programme.desc: The Vibe production team's meticulously crafted documentary series "Cultural Inheritors". The eight episodes span across various regions of China, focusing on the inheritors and artists of intangible cultural heritage. They explore and innovate with artisanal dedication, showcasing the extraordinary craftsmanship of fields such as the Ru Kiln porcelain, colored stone inlay, Pu'er tea, and Lingnan woodwork. Let’s embark on a cultural journey together, savoring the beauty of tradition and embracing the spirit of intangible cultural heritage!

programme.title: Miao Silverware: A Shining Epic
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore the fascinating world of the silver-working art of the Miao ethnic group. Join us, and hear the stories and see the works of four remarkable individuals. From a national-level inheritor who is preserving the traditional craft, to an artist infusing personal flair into his designs; from a female silversmith imbuing her work with feminine warmth, to a young artisan inspiring a new generation, we investigate the rich heritage, cultural significance, and evolving potential of Miao silverware.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 1
programme.desc: Nanjing, an ancient city that served as the capital of six imperial dynasties, stands as a testament to China's long-standing history and rich culture. From its Porcelain Tower - one of the Seven Wonders of the Middle Ages, to its grand city walls and ancient palaces, join us on a voyage across time to experience the echoes of history in Nanjing's storied bricks.

programme.title: The Art of Harmony: The Rite Society
programme.desc: “The Art of Harmony” is a documentary about Confucianism, produced by CGTN and Discovery Channel. It highlights the timeless nature of the sage’s philosophy and its global relevance today. Join us in exploring how the world might benefit from the pursuit of “The Art of Harmony”.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 2
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore the grand old mansions of Nanjing’s merchant families and take a stroll through their exquisite gardens, where Nature is incorporated into the architecture. From centuries-old Qing Dynasty residences to traditional folk handicrafts, join us on a deep dive into Nanjing’s rich cultural heritage.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 3
programme.desc: Join us in Nanjing’s bustling old quarter, where you can try on silk dresses worth their weight in gold, and see how traditional handicrafts have been given modern twists. We’ll feast on street snacks and local delicacies by the old Confucian Temple, before taking a pleasure cruise along Nanjing’s mother river to round off our exploration of this vibrant and historic city.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.1
programme.desc: Join Tianran He in Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. Fed by the Yarlung Zangbo River and abundant rainfall, this lush subtropical region is home to some of Xizan’g most unique scenery. From sacred mountains and ancient monasteries, to cruising along Nyingchi’s mother river, wandering alpine meadows and savoring stone pot chicken – a beloved local delicacy, Tianran uncovers the beauty of Nyingchi.

programme.title: Basketball dreams soar in Liangshan
programme.desc: Meet basketball girl Aguolieha, who comes from a rural village in the mountainous Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in southwest China. Playing for a local team called the Blackhawks, the 13-year-old has a big dream: to become a professional player one day and join Team China. At first, her father was not supportive as he feared that sports training would make her grades fall. Proving to be excellent both academically and on the court, she often looks up to her idol Stephen Curry, and trains hard with her peers. She believes that the sky's the limit and that basketball games will help her dreams soar.

programme.title: The sound of casting
programme.desc: For centuries, the fires of craftsmanship have never faded in Pingyao. In this UNESCO World Heritage city once famed for trade, three ancient metalworking traditions — sword casting, gold and silver crafting, and iron forging — continue to thrive. This episode steps into the workshops where artisans shape metal with fire and devotion. Each blade’s edge, each ornament’s gleam, and each curve of wrought iron tells a story of resilience and artistry — revealing how the spirit of Pingyao’s craftsmanship still glows in the heart of time.

programme.title: Indigo Dreams: A Hue of Dali Tie-dye
programme.desc: Dali Tie-dye is the unique textile art of the Bai people, renowned for its exquisite hand-tying and traditional indigo dyeing techniques that create brilliant, one-of-a-kind patterns. Explore the cultural heritage and enduring beauty of this ancient craft from Yunnan.

programme.title: Grand Song of the Dong — Natural Oriental Harmony
programme.desc: The Grand Song of the Dong is a polyphonic folk singing tradition of the Dong ethnic group. Performers from several villages gather together to sing, unaccompanied. The songs, which describe the history, beliefs, customs, and emotions of the Dong people, are an important part of their cultural identity and contribute significantly to their social cohesion. Generally sung in the Dong language, which has no written form, they are passed on orally from one generation to the next. Classified into various genres—including narrative and love songs, drinking and funeral songs—they are often accompanied by clapping, stomping, and dancing. Sung on occasions such as festivals, weddings, and funerals, the Grand Song, as a valuable part of the Dong ethnic group’s cultural heritage, reflects their wisdom and creativity, as well as their harmony with nature.

programme.title: CULTURAL INHERITORS Ancient Ru Kiln embraces its new era
programme.desc: The Vibe production team's meticulously crafted documentary series "Cultural Inheritors". The eight episodes span across various regions of China, focusing on the inheritors and artists of intangible cultural heritage. programme.title: Exploring Ethnic Attire: Dong Elegance
programme.desc: Dong clothing weaves together tradition, craftsmanship, and the unique identity of the Dong ethnic group. In this episode, we’ll unravel the stories behind the intricate designs, vibrant colors, and deep cultural significance of Dong attire. From ceremonial garments to everyday wear, each piece is imbued with the essence of a rich heritage.

programme.title: Fujian’s Tulou – The Mysterious Earthen Castles
programme.desc: The tulous, or earth-built dwellings, of Fujian are recognized as treasures of traditional architecture, thanks to their unique design, cultural importance, and embodiment of the concept of harmonious coexistence with nature. Tulous are mostly rectangular or circular in form, with a simple, elegant exterior and a well-furnished interior. As homes built by the Hakka people, they are imbued with diligence, wisdom, and the pursuit of excellence. Surrounded by mountains and waters, the tulous blend well with the natural environment. When building their tulous, the Hakka people pay attention to ecological balance in order to minimize their environmental footprint. A tulou is not only a safe place to live, but also the crystallization of the culture and architectural skill passed down for generations among the Hakka people.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He continues his journey through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He meets the Lhoba people, China’s smallest ethnic group, who show him their traditional hunting attire. At a sacred lake, Tianran visits an ancient monastery and witnesses the 3000-year-old dance of the Gongbo Tibetans, before venturing to a remote village to experience their their way of life.

programme.title: The Art of Harmony: Inseparability of Things
programme.desc: “The Art of Harmony” is a documentary about Confucianism, produced by CGTN and Discovery Channel. It highlights the timeless nature of the sage’s philosophy and its global relevance today. Join us in exploring how the world might benefit from the pursuit of “The Art of Harmony”.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.3
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He rounds off his travels through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He journeys into the Yarlung Zangbo Grand Canyon – one of the largest and deepest canyons on Earth, and along the way, tries to catch a glimpse of Mount Namcha Barwa, the easternmost peak of the Himalayas. Instead, he encounters a waterfall said to be a gateway to the afterlife, before finally arriving at the entrance to the canyon.

programme.title: Wenzhou
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Wenzhou, southeast China — a city famed for its self-made millionaires. Here he meets the first Chinese shoemaker to expand overseas, and hears the stories of other local entrepreneurs. Along the way, he samples traditional snacks, visits some of China’s oldest lighthouses, and enjoys an evening of Ou Opera. He also learns the craft of papermaking, before heading into the hills to soak in hot springs and wander across ancient covered bridges.

programme.title: Outkirts of Wenzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He explores Wenzhou’s counties. From geological wonders and daring cliffside stunts at the Yandang Mountains, to rafting along the scenic Nanxi River, to harvesting seaweed and shellfish on the mud flats of the Dongtou Islands, Tianran discovers the ingenious ways the people of Wenzhou have transformed the challenges of living between mountains and seas into their greatest strengths.

programme.title: Dreams beyond the acrobatic stage
programme.desc: Many young acrobats from across China have gathered in Wuqiao, Cangzhou in north China's Hebei Province, with one shared goal: to dazzle audiences with their talents and stunt skills. They usually starts to train at an early age, shouldering the hopes and support of their families and teachers to become successful performers. We followed three of these young performers to show you how incredibly talented they are.

programme.title: Echoes of Green
programme.desc: Echoes of Green takes viewers deep into Anji’s bamboo forests and mountain villages, where a new generation of Chinese youth is redefining how to live with nature. Through stories of outdoor sports, forest cafés, tea rituals, and family farms, the series shows how ecological ideals have become everyday choices and creative lifestyles. It is not just about landscapes, but about people — young dreamers proving that prosperity and nature can grow side by side, and that culture gives life to sustainability.

programme.title: Quyang Stone Carving
programme.desc: Quyang is known as a hometown of Chinese carving. Quyang's stone carving works are popular around different parts of China, thus also exported to over 100 countries and regions worldwide. The style of Quyang stone carving both carries the mysterious and rough spirit of the Wei Dynasty and the natural and graceful forms of the Tang and Song dynasties. It reflects the life experiences and live philosophies of local artisans. Each statue's showcases unique oriental aesthetics.

programme.title: Nanjing Yunjin Brocade: A Traditional Chinese Silk Craft
programme.desc: Nanjing Yunjin Brocade, a traditional Chinese silk handicraft with a history spanning over 1,600 years, derives its name from its radiant and resplendent hues, which resemble clouds in the sky. Renowned for its exquisite materials, meticulous weaving techniques, and vibrant, splendid patterns, Yunjin Brocade is hailed as the "king of brocades." It represents the pinnacle of Chinese silk weaving techniques, encapsulates the essence of Chinese silk craftsmanship, and stands as a brilliant crystallization of China’s silk culture. The core technique of Yunjin Brocade weaving—known as "weaving through the warp and cutting the weft"—is executed manually by two artisans working above and below complex, large-scale looms. Using materials such as silk floss, gold thread, and peacock feather threads, they create luxurious fabrics like imperial dragon robes. To this day, Yunjin Brocade continues to be used in crafting high-end clothing and souvenirs. Creating Yunjin Brocade involves over 120 intricate and sophisticated processes before the final masterpiece takes shape. Having traversed over a millennium, its majestic and luxurious aura remains unchanged. Just like the Qinhuai River, which has flowed through Nanjing for over 3,000 years—clear and steadfast—its gentle currents cut through the annals of history as it journeys toward an even more distant future.

programme.title: A Vibe of the Village: The Beat of Xiangxi Drums
programme.desc: Experience the vibrant power of Xiangxi Drum Dance. This program delves into the heart of Tujia and Miao cultures, showcasing the rhythmic beats and spirited performances that have echoed through West Hunan's mountains for centuries. Discover the stories, traditions, and raw energy of this captivating folk art.

programme.title: Kesi
programme.desc: Silk is a classic symbol of Chinese culture. It helped opened up economic and cultural exchanges between East and West and witnessed the spread of Eastern civilization to the world. As a representative of traditional Chinese silk art, kesi is renowned for its highly ornamental weaving techniques of highlighting warps and breaking wefts, and has been deeply loved by people for thousands of years. In folk culture, it enjoys the reputation of “an inch of kesi is worth an inch of gold.”

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.3
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He rounds off his travels through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He journeys into the Yarlung Zangbo Grand Canyon – one of the largest and deepest canyons on Earth, and along the way, tries to catch a glimpse of Mount Namcha Barwa, the easternmost peak of the Himalayas. Instead, he encounters a waterfall said to be a gateway to the afterlife, before finally arriving at the entrance to the canyon.

programme.title: Wenzhou
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Wenzhou, southeast China — a city famed for its self-made millionaires. Here he meets the first Chinese shoemaker to expand overseas, and hears the stories of other local entrepreneurs. Along the way, he samples traditional snacks, visits some of China’s oldest lighthouses, and enjoys an evening of Ou Opera. He also learns the craft of papermaking, before heading into the hills to soak in hot springs and wander across ancient covered bridges.

programme.title: Outkirts of Wenzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He explores Wenzhou’s counties. From geological wonders and daring cliffside stunts at the Yandang Mountains, to rafting along the scenic Nanxi River, to harvesting seaweed and shellfish on the mud flats of the Dongtou Islands, Tianran discovers the ingenious ways the people of Wenzhou have transformed the challenges of living between mountains and seas into their greatest strengths.

programme.title: Dreams beyond the acrobatic stage
programme.desc: Many young acrobats from across China have gathered in Wuqiao, Cangzhou in north China's Hebei Province, with one shared goal: to dazzle audiences with their talents and stunt skills. They usually starts to train at an early age, shouldering the hopes and support of their families and teachers to become successful performers. We followed three of these young performers to show you how incredibly talented they are.

programme.title: Echoes of Green
programme.desc: Echoes of Green takes viewers deep into Anji’s bamboo forests and mountain villages, where a new generation of Chinese youth is redefining how to live with nature. Through stories of outdoor sports, forest cafés, tea rituals, and family farms, the series shows how ecological ideals have become everyday choices and creative lifestyles. It is not just about landscapes, but about people — young dreamers proving that prosperity and nature can grow side by side, and that culture gives life to sustainability.

programme.title: Quyang Stone Carving
programme.desc: Quyang is known as a hometown of Chinese carving. Quyang's stone carving works are popular around different parts of China, thus also exported to over 100 countries and regions worldwide. The style of Quyang stone carving both carries the mysterious and rough spirit of the Wei Dynasty and the natural and graceful forms of the Tang and Song dynasties. It reflects the life experiences and live philosophies of local artisans. Each statue's showcases unique oriental aesthetics.

programme.title: Nanjing Yunjin Brocade: A Traditional Chinese Silk Craft
programme.desc: Nanjing Yunjin Brocade, a traditional Chinese silk handicraft with a history spanning over 1,600 years, derives its name from its radiant and resplendent hues, which resemble clouds in the sky. Renowned for its exquisite materials, meticulous weaving techniques, and vibrant, splendid patterns, Yunjin Brocade is hailed as the "king of brocades." It represents the pinnacle of Chinese silk weaving techniques, encapsulates the essence of Chinese silk craftsmanship, and stands as a brilliant crystallization of China’s silk culture. The core technique of Yunjin Brocade weaving—known as "weaving through the warp and cutting the weft"—is executed manually by two artisans working above and below complex, large-scale looms. Using materials such as silk floss, gold thread, and peacock feather threads, they create luxurious fabrics like imperial dragon robes. To this day, Yunjin Brocade continues to be used in crafting high-end clothing and souvenirs. Creating Yunjin Brocade involves over 120 intricate and sophisticated processes before the final masterpiece takes shape. Having traversed over a millennium, its majestic and luxurious aura remains unchanged. Just like the Qinhuai River, which has flowed through Nanjing for over 3,000 years—clear and steadfast—its gentle currents cut through the annals of history as it journeys toward an even more distant future.

programme.title: CULTURAL INHERITORS Ancient Ru Kiln embraces its new era
programme.desc: The Vibe production team's meticulously crafted documentary series "Cultural Inheritors". The eight episodes span across various regions of China, focusing on the inheritors and artists of intangible cultural heritage. They explore and innovate with artisanal dedication, showcasing the extraordinary craftsmanship of fields such as the Ru Kiln porcelain, colored stone inlay, Pu'er tea, and Lingnan woodwork. Let’s embark on a cultural journey together, savoring the beauty of tradition and embracing the spirit of intangible cultural heritage!

programme.title: A Vibe of the Village: The Beat of Xiangxi Drums
programme.desc: Experience the vibrant power of Xiangxi Drum Dance. This program delves into the heart of Tujia and Miao cultures, showcasing the rhythmic beats and spirited performances that have echoed through West Hunan's mountains for centuries. Discover the stories, traditions, and raw energy of this captivating folk art.

programme.title: Kesi
programme.desc: Silk is a classic symbol of Chinese culture. It helped opened up economic and cultural exchanges between East and West and witnessed the spread of Eastern civilization to the world. As a representative of traditional Chinese silk art, kesi is renowned for its highly ornamental weaving techniques of highlighting warps and breaking wefts, and has been deeply loved by people for thousands of years. In folk culture, it enjoys the reputation of “an inch of kesi is worth an inch of gold.”

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He continues his journey through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He meets the Lhoba people, China’s smallest ethnic group, who show him their traditional hunting attire. At a sacred lake, Tianran visits an ancient monastery and witnesses the 3000-year-old dance of the Gongbo Tibetans, before venturing to a remote village to experience their their way of life.
