programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E01 - Man Eating Crocodiles of Zimbabwe
programme.desc: Mario takes a huge gamble by rafting along Africa's most dangerous river, the Zambezi, heading towards Lake Reba. But he ends up face-to-face with some of the largest and most fearsome man-eating crocodiles around.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E02 - Namibian Desert Oryx
programme.desc: Mario heard from some locals about a strange-looking creature deep in the Namibian desert. So, he decided to brave the sweltering heat in a hot air balloon to track down the oryx.

programme.title: Wardens - S06:E12 - Hidden Truth
programme.desc: When Wardens stop a truck on the first of November with Christmas trees in the back, they know something is being hidden. Most likely the truth.

programme.title: Wardens - S06:E13 - Back Country Patrol
programme.desc: Wardens do way more than just drive around in trucks and check licenses. This week the Region One wardens go off the grid to protect the natural resources of Montana U.S.A.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E05 - The Planet Makers
programme.desc: From the beginnings of our Solar System four and half billion years ago there remains tantalizing clues to its evolution; remnent debris: asteroids and comets. They vary in size from grains of dust to mountain sides, footballs to planetoids. They were the building Now within our grasp these rocks of ice and dust are ready to give up their secrets.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E06 - The Ice Giants
programme.desc: Beyond the asteroid belt lay the ice giants, some can be seen with the naked eye, others only glimpsed once by a passing probe. We are again sending cameras to the edge of the solar system giving us The New insights into the evolution of our worlds.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E01 - Terry's Criminal Mind
programme.desc: A murderer tries to kill his final victim as the car they are in slowly sinks to the bottom of a lake. The only way to save the victim is to rescue her as the car continues to sink. We test fire multiple handguns underwater to see if you can actually penetrate a car windshield and save the victim.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E02 - Shark Go Boom!
programme.desc: In Jaws, Chief Brody hangs on to his sinking boat as a giant shark approaches him with a scuba tank lodged in its mouth. We construct a giant shark on a motorized platform to test if you can hit, and explode, the tank with an M1 Garand rifle while perched in a precarious position.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E17 - Remembering Diana Princess Of Wales
programme.desc: Remembering Diana, Princess of Wales includes scenes from her state funeral and heartfelt words from her closest friends. It's a warm and reflective look at Diana both as a person and a public figure: the queen that never was and the princess who'll always be remembered.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E05 - Gang Wars
programme.desc: Ivan Carter investigates an African black market poaching operation.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E12 - Naturally Vibrant
programme.desc: South Moravia in the Czech Republic is home to a wide variety of beautiful orchids. From there we go to the Caribbean to Cuba with its unbelievably beautiful vistas contrasted with brutal cock fighting. From Cuba we travel to Fiji in the Pacific Ocean – often considered to be a true paradise on Earth.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E13 - Naturally Hewn
programme.desc: In this episode we travel from the South to the North of the Holy Land, Israel, stopping to admire the views and soak in the biblical import of the historic sites. On to the Golan Heights in the North where recent conflict is in still much in evidence and concluding our pilgrimage on the shores of Galilee.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E01 - Naturally Wild
programme.desc: Many islands lie in the sea between Great Britain and Scandinavia. All of these islands would have remaind snow-covered and life would not have been sustainable were it not for the Gulf Stream. The warm waters flowing through the Atlantic Ocean all the way to South America account for the mild island climate, rich nature and history that reaches back thousands of years. Such are the three islands we are about to visit in today’s Miracles of Nature – Vesterålen, the Fair Isle and the Orkneys.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E02- Naturally Noble
programme.desc: Zimbabwe was initially Southern Rhodesia and lies to the south of the Victoria Falls along the river Zambezi. Zambia was initially Northern Rhodesia and lies on the other bank of the river. Zimbabwe is a landlocked country in the south-east of Africa. It borders with South Africa to the south. According to archaeologists, the earliest records indicate that first human settlements in this area reach back to the 3rd century.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S04:E07 - Montana Elk
programme.desc: Laramy teams up with his friend and a kindred spirit, Clayton Marxer, to hunt Elk in Montana.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S04:E08 - Alaska Caribou
programme.desc: Laramy is hunting Caribou in Mountain Man country - Alaska - but his plans are interrupted when he discovers the prints of a large bear.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S04:E09 - Bear
programme.desc: Laramy hunts for spring black bear in the Rocky Mountains with his Hawken rifle. Learn some skinning techniques and uses of black bear meat, fur, and fat.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S04:E10 - Montana Whitetail
programme.desc: Laramy embraces the challeges presented when hunting Whitetail deer in Montana.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E04 - Battle Plans
programme.desc: Surviving in the wild often means being able to fight and win. This fighting strategy is called agonism and is used to set ranks, get resources, claim territory, and attract partners. There's no certainty in the wild, but animals that get good at agonism have a better shot at living to see another day.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E05 - Masters of Attack
programme.desc: Carnivores can't just pick their meals off trees. To survive, they have to use every trick they've got to catch food that's just as keen on staying alive as they are. If their prey hides, they have to find it. If it runs, they must chase it. They have to track it if it's hard to pin down and beat it if it fights back. The predator might use its strength for the final blow, but the real effort lies in the strategy.

programme.desc: Laramy is hunting Caribou in Mountain Man country - Alaska - but his plans are interrupted when he discovers the prints of a large bear.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S04:E09 - Bear
programme.desc: Laramy hunts for spring black bear in the Rocky Mountains with his Hawken rifle. Learn some skinning techniques and uses of black bear meat, fur, and fat.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S04:E10 - Montana Whitetail
programme.desc: Laramy embraces the challeges presented when hunting Whitetail deer in Montana.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E04 - Battle Plans
programme.desc: Surviving in the wild often means being able to fight and win. This fighting strategy is called agonism and is used to set ranks, get resources, claim territory, and attract partners. There's no certainty in the wild, but animals that get good at agonism have a better shot at living to see another day.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E05 - Masters of Attack
programme.desc: Carnivores can't just pick their meals off trees. To survive, they have to use every trick they've got to catch food that's just as keen on staying alive as they are. If their prey hides, they have to find it. If it runs, they must chase it. They have to track it if it's hard to pin down and beat it if it fights back. The predator might use its strength for the final blow, but the real effort lies in the strategy.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E05 - Gang Wars
programme.desc: Ivan Carter investigates an African black market poaching operation.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E12 - Naturally Vibrant
programme.desc: South Moravia in the Czech Republic is home to a wide variety of beautiful orchids. From there we go to the Caribbean to Cuba with its unbelievably beautiful vistas contrasted with brutal cock fighting. From Cuba we travel to Fiji in the Pacific Ocean – often considered to be a true paradise on Earth.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E13 - Naturally Hewn
programme.desc: In this episode we travel from the South to the North of the Holy Land, Israel, stopping to admire the views and soak in the biblical import of the historic sites. On to the Golan Heights in the North where recent conflict is in still much in evidence and concluding our pilgrimage on the shores of Galilee.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E01 - Naturally Wild
programme.desc: Many islands lie in the sea between Great Britain and Scandinavia. All of these islands would have remaind snow-covered and life would not have been sustainable were it not for the Gulf Stream. The warm waters flowing through the Atlantic Ocean all the way to South America account for the mild island climate, rich nature and history that reaches back thousands of years. Such are the three islands we are about to visit in today’s Miracles of Nature – Vesterålen, the Fair Isle and the Orkneys.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E02- Naturally Noble
programme.desc: Zimbabwe was initially Southern Rhodesia and lies to the south of the Victoria Falls along the river Zambezi. Zambia was initially Northern Rhodesia and lies on the other bank of the river. Zimbabwe is a landlocked country in the south-east of Africa. It borders with South Africa to the south. According to archaeologists, the earliest records indicate that first human settlements in this area reach back to the 3rd century.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E09 - Queen Camilla
programme.desc: The documentary Queen Camilla? takes a closer look at Camilla Parker-Bowles, covering her history, her life, and what lies ahead. It focuses on her long standing ties with Prince Charles. The film also delves into the drama around Camilla's role in Prince Charles's marriage to Princess Diana.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E07 - William And Kate Into The Future
programme.desc: From a regular student to a royal girlfriend, Kate Middleton has transformed into a real-life princess. In less than ten years, this everyday girl with a normal background captured her prince's heart and is now on track to become the future Queen of England.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E03 - Kalahari Bushmen
programme.desc: In the Kalahari desert, there’s an old tribe living off the land. Mario spends a week working hard to gather food to share with them.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E04 - Untouched Atolls
programme.desc: Nur vor der Küste Afrikas liegt ein Streifen von 115 Inseln namens Seychellen. Mario erklärt seinem Publikum, wie man Riffarten angelt. Aus dem Nichts heraus versucht er sogar, mit einem Fächerfisch zu schwimmen.

programme.title: Wardens - S06:E14 - Double Kill
programme.desc: Montana U.S.A. Region 5 has a rash of illegal elk kills and it's down to the Wardens to investigate them.

programme.title: Wardens - S06:E15 - Hot Mess
programme.desc: Wardens gear up for the last week of the season. The pressure is on, putting the Wardens right in the middle of a hot mess.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E07 - The Moons of Olympus
programme.desc: These are the the Moon's of the gas giants. Each a unique and mysterious world of its own. Some have oceans of water, geysers of Sulphur or atmospheres of plastic. Some are just now being seen at the outer rim of our solar system, all are worthy of much more scrutiny.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E08 - The Sun
programme.desc: It powers the machinery of nature; our weather, encourages and sustains life on land and at sea. When it sets in the West it reveals to us its many billions of sibling stars populating the night sky. We study our Sun closely, and like a Rosetta stone it can reveal the secrets of all the other stars above.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E03 - The Good, The Bad and Terry
programme.desc: In this classic western, Clint Eastwood - aka "Blondie" - saves Eli Wallach from the hangman's noose three separate times by shooting and severing the rope that he hangs from. We recreate each scene and test the reality of these shots with the weapons that were used.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E04 - Dying Hard
programme.desc: John McLain (Bruce Willis) finds himself dangling from the side of a building. The only way to save himself is to shoot through the glass window and break through to safety. Using the same Beretta 92 handgun, we reconstruct the office glass and see if our host can break through.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E11 - Royal Children Prince William and Prince Harry
programme.desc: Two young men who have had to cope with extraordinarily challenging events and circumstances as, together, they have gone on to change the face of the British royal family and carve meaningful roles for themselves in the modern world. programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E25 - Kate The Making Of A Modern Queen
programme.desc: A look at the Duchess of Cambridge's journey from being an everyday young woman to becoming a future queen, and what her evolution signifies for the royal family.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E05 - Heartbreak Tuna Capetown
programme.desc: Mario wagt sich tief in den Ozean vor der Küste Kapstadts, um riesige Gelbflossen-Thunfische zu fangen, stellt jedoch fest, dass er sich mehr vorgenommen hat, als er bewältigen kann.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E06 - Getting Close to Black Death
programme.desc: In den Wildnissen des nördlichen Südafrikas ist Wilderei allgegenwärtig und die Wildnis könnte nicht gefährlicher sein. Mario möchte die erste Person in der Region sein, die einen Kaffernbüffel mit Pfeil und Bogen jagt.

programme.title: Wardens - S06:E16 - Long Day
programme.desc: When Elk start to migrate, the days get long. Wardens keep an eye on the herd and find that at night things start to get strange.

programme.title: Wardens - S06:E17 - Bad Decisions
programme.desc: Ethical hunters make the right decisions every day. This week, Wardens find themselves confronted with bad decisions.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E09 - Exo Planets
programme.desc: As scientists and astronomers peer closer at nearby stars with ever more fidelity they are discovering planets; exo planets, worlds outside our own solar system. With technological advances and improved techniques scientists are discovering more and more worlds every day. With confidence scientists now calculated there could be as many as 40 billion Earth like planets in our Milky Way galaxy alone.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E10 - Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe the further back in time we reach. What we see in the night sky is only a small percentage of the contents of the Universe, most is dark matter and dark energy we know it exists; however its nature eludes us for the moment.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E05 - Schapbo
programme.desc: John Rambo's ability to decimate enemies all by himself has created some of the most incredible weapon stunts in Hollywood history. We test the reality surrounding these iconic scenes from this blockbuster franchise.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E06 - Terry And The Minigun
programme.desc: Can you really fire a GE Minigun handheld with ammunition held in a backpack (also seen on Predator (1987). Additionally, for one of our larger tests - can you actually chop down a jungle forest with a Minigun? Actor Bill Duke - who co-starred with Arnold Schwarzenegger for the film and who's character performed this weapon stunt - joins us to find out. But first, we have to build a jungle.

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E09 - Weary Travellers
programme.desc: R.L. and Casey travel far from their camp to reach the heart of moose country as the rut begins. Meanwhile, Chris looks into finding a new way out because of the rough weather.

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E10 - Lifted
programme.desc: As their Alaskan adventure wraps up, Kaid and R.L. think about what really counts in life and what they've discovered about living. Lifelong bonds are stronger than ever as they get ready to leave Alaska.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E01 - Empty Handed
programme.desc: In remote areas, survival is an everyday game. Enter hosts Chris and Casey Keefer as they set out to survive 30 days in the backcountry. Each new day these brothers will pit their skills as hunters, woodsmen, and fishermen against an unforgiving and relentless landscape. DROPPED brings viewers face to face with the harsh reality of only being able to eat what you can kill. A true test of survival. The Keefer brothers put boots to ground as their journey through Alaska begins. Armed with nothing but a couple Glock 20s, the brothers immediately begin their search for their first supply-yielding catch.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E02 - Long Days, Cold Nights
programme.desc: The Keefer brothers awaken to a frozen tundra. With over 8 miles to cover and no oars, the brothers are forced to trudge their way through shallow water and barren earth as they head downstream in search of their second cache.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E03 - Choke Point
programme.desc: The terrain begins to change as the Keefer brothers are forced to pick their way downstream. The landscape tightens it's grip and funnels the brothers to a geographic choke point where both predator and prey gather.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E12 - Environmental Disaster
programme.desc: Better safe than sorry…… Desperate Hours takes a look at the Kyoto Protocol and the danger of rising sea levels. The programme looks at the causes of environmental disasters including landfill waste, the great Pacific Garbage Patch, oil spills, air pollution, and the destruction of the rain forest as well as the destructive effects of environmental disasters including ozone depletion and rising temperatures in the arctic.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E13 - Desperate World
programme.desc: Desperate Hours examines some of the worst of the worst disasters in the world. It looks at the Eyjafjallajökull eruption in Iceland, earthquakes in Nepal. epidemics like Ebola and SARS, the Binhai New Development Zone fire in China, Hurricane Sandy in New York, the southeast Asia Indian Ocean Tsunami, a destructive sinkhole in Bosnia, the Fukushima Nuclear Plant disaster, the Bhopal gas disaster, the Exxon Valdez crash in Alaska, and traffic and airplane accidents.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E01 - Lost!
programme.desc: Nick and Laura subject themselves to intense survival training with the Survival Training School of California deep in the mountains.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E02 - Sniper Science
programme.desc: Nick and Laura explore the variety of skills that military snipers use: marksmanship, long range shooting, detection, stalking, camouflage, infiltration, special reconnaissance and target acquisition.

programme.title: Survival Science - - S01:E03 - Surviving a Bear Attack
programme.desc: Nick and Laura test the power and speed of grizzly bears using Hollywood stunt tools to experience an attack. Also: an attempt to recreate an arrow shot that saved a man from a bear attack.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E09 - Thriving

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E42 - Diana A Model Princess
programme.desc: Diana's fashion sense was something people often looked at closely. She had a knack for picking outfits that were both stylish and sophisticated, which always grabbed attention. Her hats were another standout feature; she often wore elegant designs that added a touch of grace to her look. Her hair was also iconic, usually styled neatly with a slight bounce, perfectly framing her face and adding to her elegant appearance.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E45 - Charles A Portrait A Man Alone
programme.desc: This tells the tale of a man juggling the stress of his public obligations with the challenges of a failing marriage that's playing out in front of the world. It's a special look at the man fated to become King.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E07 - Hawaii Access Shane Dorian
programme.desc: The number of axis deer in Hawaii has exploded, making them a big problem for this stunning Pacific paradise. In this episode, Mario meets up with Shane Dorian, a big wave surfer, as they head out on an expedition.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E08 - Talking Turkey Frank Stallone
programme.desc: Mario teams up with Frank Stalone and heads to Kansas to find Easton turkeys. With Frank's Italian roots, Mario is sure they can create turkey meatballs that taste incredible.

programme.title: Wardens - S06:E18 - Fly By
programme.desc: Wardens set up a check station in Montana U.S.A. Region 5. When the hunters decide to run it, the chase is on.

programme.title: Wardens - S06:E19 - Road Warrior
programme.desc: Wardens set up a decoy to stop road hunting in Montana U.S.A. Region 7. It's not long before they catch a shooter.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E01 - Astronauts
programme.desc: One hundred kilometres above the Earth’s surface lies an invisible frontier: the edge of space. This is the Karman Line, the boundary between our planet’s atmosphere and what lies beyond. What does it take to cross that line?

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E02 - Getting UpThere
programme.desc: Launching payloads into space is a very difficult task, historically rocket launches are the proverbial 'swords into ploughshares' Missiles designed to carry atomic warheads now send satellites and probes into the solar system. Ironically it's one of the few exploits Mankind undertakes that doesn't occur in nature.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E07 - Scoreless
programme.desc: Using a unique method to crack a safe, Nick Wells (Robert De Niro) uses a blowtorch to cut through a safe, fill it with water, and blow the door off using a small explosive device. We test this, along with the effects of a 20mm antitank rifle on a safe from the movie Thuderbolt and Lightfoot.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E08 - Terry Vs Gorn
programme.desc: Terry and Larry test out Star Trek on the set of Star Trek Original Series set tours in Upstate NY Terry and Larry find them selves on board the USS Enterprise and they test the theory that Kirk could have made a cannon from a Bamboo tube Magnesium Powder and Stone Knives and BareSkins It worked on Star Trek but would it really work ?

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E12 - The New Royals
programme.desc: Princesses Beatrice and Eugenie have gone through a lot of media attention and tough situations in their lives. From their parents' very public split to being targeted by the press, they've been through quite a bit. Despite all this, they remain dedicated to supporting the monarchy with their charity work. Through serving the Commonwealth, both sisters continue to make a positive impact.

programme.title: Roots of the Nation Ep.1
programme.desc: Explores agricultural modernization and innovation in China, uncovering the forces behind these transformative changes and answering the century-old question: "Who will feed China in the 21st century?"

programme.title: The Grand Canal Ep.7
programme.desc: With the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal as longitude and its 3,000-year history as latitude, this series traces the canal's development from multiple angles, tells the life stories of those along its banks, and reveals the unique status of this world cultural heritage.

programme.title: The Fish-shaped Lanterns That Have Been
programme.desc: Meet Pan Min, a content creator documenting fish lantern culture who also designs study tours to boost village tourism. Alongside inheritor Wang Fengcheng, they're finding creative ways to keep the traditional craft afloat, opening a new chapter in fish lantern culture.

programme.title: Yingge Dance: A Celebration of Heroes
programme.desc: The Yingge Dance always brings a festive energy to the Lunar New Year in southern China’s Chaoshan area, capturing the nation's attention in the process. With every strike of their mallets, a deep sense of nostalgia and cultural pride reverberates through China's youth. This episode follows animator Zhu Xiaopeng as he trains with inheritor He Murong, using modern technology to keep the spirit of Yingge alive.

programme.title: The Lush Green Gannan Ep.1
programme.desc: This documentary captures the remarkable transformation of Gannan over the past decade, a region that serves as a critical water source and recharge zone for the upper reaches of the Yellow and Yangtze rivers, a national ecological functional area, and a pilot zone for ecological civilization.

programme.title: The Shadow of an Empire Ep.1
programme.desc: Visit the Eastern Qing Tombs at the foot of Changrui Mountain in Zunhua, Hebei, the burial site of China's last imperial dynasty. Resting here are the Emperors Shunzhi and Kangxi, as well as the Empress Dowager Cixi and other Qing royalty. Through these tombs, the documentary brings to life the former glory and fading echoes of the Great Qing Empire.

programme.title: The Shadow of an Empire Ep.1
programme.desc: Visit the Eastern Qing Tombs at the foot of Changrui Mountain in Zunhua, Hebei, the burial site of China's last imperial dynasty. Resting here are the Emperors Shunzhi and Kangxi, as well as the Empress Dowager Cixi and other Qing royalty. Through these tombs, the documentary brings to life the former glory and fading echoes of the Great Qing Empire.

Built by automotive enthusiasts, for automotive enthusiasts.
